stock_queries: balloon garland setup living room party
why: Series #1 "Empty to Party" uses the satisfying setup-to-reveal mechanic of the balloon wall prep Short (5,722,533 views) and the "Typical Saturday Baby Shower" format (1,951,378 views). The goal is to show real NYC setup work and lead busy parents straight to WhatsApp booking.

problems: Hook 'Empty room. Two hours later.' promises a before/after reveal, but the first frame shows only purple foil curtains and no real transformation
Captions are split mid-sentence ('with no time to', 'We set up in') and do not line up with the images
Frame at 5.9s shows kids jumping at a home party with no visible balloon decor, so it does not match 'We set up in' or the service
Frame at 2.5s shows a woman holding a gold confetti circle in a hammock, which is not balloon decor and shows no garlands or arches
Frame at 4.2s is a generic stock shot of a person lounging with balloons, not real work
qa.fix: Replace the stock clips and the Tepexa end card with real Made for Happy NYC footage: an empty room, then the finished garland and arch, then a closing card with the brand name and a 'Message us on WhatsApp' CTA with the number.
